basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer who recently stumbled upon Reddit while looking for tips on improving my game in Golf Clash. I'm a 29-year-old software tester living in Cape Town, South Africa. When I'm not working, I spend time exploring new video games and occasionally dipping my toes into long-forgotten classics like Age of Mythology. Mostly active online in the evenings after work. Single and enjoying the freedom to game and explore new hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Primarily self-taught in gaming strategies through forums, YouTube tutorials, and trial and error. My background in software testing gives me an analytical edge in understanding game mechanics and troubleshooting issues.
